name: Double Face
source:
Ryou arrives to the school male dormitory and hears rumors that dormitory is cursed. Will he his youth days pass happily around the girls or will the curse impede his plans?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
凉来到学校男生宿舍，听说这里遭到了诅咒。他的青春岁月会在女孩们的陪伴下幸福度过，还是会被诅咒搅乱？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
